import pandas as pd

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_nhe_source_of_funds.xlsx', sheet_name='Table 3', header=None)
header_row = df.iloc[1]
med_row = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Medicare'].index[0]
years = []
for c in range(1, df.shape[1]):
    val = pd.to_numeric(df.iat[med_row, c], errors='coerce')
    yr = str(header_row[c]).split('.')[0].strip()
    if pd.notna(val) and yr.isdigit() and val >= 1000:
        years.append(yr)
result = years[0]

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_nhe_source_of_funds.xlsx', sheet_name='Table 3', header=None)
header_row = df.iloc[1].astype(str).str.strip()
inv_row = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower() == 'investment'].index[0]
target_years = [str(y) for y in range(2020, 2025)]
cols = [c for c in range(1, df.shape[1]) if any(str(header_row[c]).startswith(y) for y in target_years)]
result = float(df.iloc[inv_row, cols].astype(float).sum())
